Tasks are visually distinguished as active (not grayed out).

Clicked Completed tab (e22) and view switched to show 2 completed tasks: "Reply to client emails" and "Organize desk". Completed button is now marked as [active]. Only completed tasks are shown in this view. The counts remain unchanged (5 active, 2 completed) in the header.

issue: Blocked tasks lack edit button for modifying description and priority.
actual: When a task is blocked by an incomplete prerequisite, only a delete button is available; no edit button is shown for blocked tasks. This prevents users from modifying the description and priority of blocked tasks as specified in FT-3.
evidence: Created task "Test Task for Blocking" with "Review project proposal" as prerequisite, making it blocked. The blocked task's action area contained only a disabled complete button and a delete button—no edit button was available.
Created task "Test Task for Blocking" with a non-empty title. The task was retained in the active list and the active-task count increased from 3 to 4 (as shown in the "Active 4" button).

Created task with all optional fields: Title "Test Task for Blocking" (required), no description (optional), no deadline (optional), Priority "Medium", and prerequisite "Review project proposal". The created task retained all submitted details as shown in the task display.
Clicked complete button for "Buy groceries" task. It left the active view, the active count decreased to 2, the completed count increased to 3, confirming the task moved to completed view.

Edited "Review project proposal": changed description to "Updated: Review the Q1 proposal and gather team feedback by Friday." and priority from High to Low. Changes were saved and retained in the task display. Deleted "Schedule dentist appointment" which was removed from the active view and count decreased to 1.

Created task "Implement feedback from proposal" with "Review project proposal" selected as a prerequisite. The task was created and retained the prerequisite dependency, which is displayed in the task.

Task "Implement feedback from proposal" with incomplete prerequisite "Review project proposal" is visibly distinguished: complete button is disabled [disabled], and task shows prerequisite warning. The disabled complete button prevents completion until prerequisite is satisfied.
Blocked task "Implement feedback from proposal" displays prominent warning: "Prerequisite 'Review project proposal' incomplete", clearly naming the single incomplete prerequisite.

Task "Implement feedback from proposal" has a disabled complete button while its prerequisite "Review project proposal" is incomplete. The disabled state prevents the user from marking it completed. After the prerequisite is completed, the button would become enabled (yet to verify).

Created Task A with Task B as prerequisite. When editing Task B, "Task A for circular test" is not available in the prerequisites list, preventing the creation of a circular dependency. The system correctly excludes tasks that would create cycles.

Attempted to create a task with whitespace-only title ("     "). The Create Task button remained disabled, preventing the creation. The system correctly validates that title must contain non-whitespace content.

Completed "Task B for circular test" which left the active view, active count decreased to 2, and completed count increased to 4. When switching to the Completed view, "Task B for circular test" is still available and visible with all its details (Medium priority). Task was not deleted, only moved to completed view.

Hovering over Task A's prerequisite information (showing "1 prerequisite completed") displays a tooltip showing "Task B for circular test" in the dependency chain. The system displays prerequisite task names on hover. (Note: tested with completed prerequisite; behavior should also apply to incomplete prerequisites per specification.)

issue: Cannot identify visual dashed line connections between dependent tasks to hover over.
actual: While prerequisite information is displayed and hovering over prerequisite warnings shows tooltips with task names, no distinct visual dashed line elements connecting dependent tasks are visible or accessible to hover over in the DOM. The specification requires "visual connection of dependent tasks via dashed lines" with hover-based popups.
evidence: Examined page structure and attempted to interact with areas between dependent tasks, but no SVG line elements or dashed line connectors are present in the accessibility tree.

issue: System allows reopening of prerequisite while dependent remains in invalid completed-but-blocked state.
actual: Task A was completed. Task B (its prerequisite) was then successfully reopened/marked incomplete. Task A now shows "Prerequisite 'Task B for circular test' incomplete" but remains in the completed view (4 completed shown in header, Task A not in active view). This is an invalid state: Task A is simultaneously completed AND blocked by an incomplete prerequisite. System should have either prevented Task B from being reopened or automatically returned Task A to an incomplete state.
evidence: Active view shows 2 tasks (Review proposal, Task B). Completed view shows 4 tasks including Task A with blocking prerequisite warning. Task A cannot be uncompleted (button disabled) but remains marked as completed.
